SELECT ff.avid AS folder_uid, ff.name, ff.is_default, ff.is_private, ff.description, ff.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.episode_favorite ef WHERE ef.folder_id = ff.id AND ef.status = 1) AS "count", COALESCE(ff.cover_url, (SELECT vi.cover_url FROM public.episode_favorite ef INNER JOIN public.video_episode ve ON ve.id = ef.episode_id AND ve.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN public.video_info vi ON vi.id = ve.video_id AND vi.is_delete = 0 WHERE ef.folder_id = ff.id AND ef.status = 1 ORDER BY ef.create_time DESC LIMIT 1)) AS cover_url FROM public.favorite_folder ff WHERE ff.user_id = #{userId} AND ff.is_delete = 0
AND ff.is_private = 0
ORDER BY ff.is_default DESC, ff.create_time ASC
